about: Secret-shaped values that have to ship, for scripts/rule-checks.mjs secrets. Each entry names the file and the sha256 of the matched value (never the value itself) and says why it may be public. A browser key belongs here only if it is restricted where it is issued (HTTP referrers, one API).

allowed.reason: YouTube Data API key the dev app store sends from the browser; it ships to every visitor, so it must be referrer-restricted in Google Cloud (to confirm).
The same YouTube Data API browser key, in the dev config.
